name: fieldset
description: Groups related fields with a legend, description, and inherited disabled state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the part and everything inside it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Use the destructive border and focus ring; provide an accessible error explanation.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description:
An accessibility hint helps users understand what will happen when they perform
an action on the accessibility element when that result is not obvious from the
accessibility label.


See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilityHint

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description:
Overrides the text that's read by the screen reader when the user interacts
with the element. By default, the label is constructed by traversing all
the children and accumulating all the `Text` nodes separated by space.

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilitylabel

props.name: accessibilityState
props.description: Indicates to accessibility services that UI Component is in a specific State.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: hitSlop
props.description:
This defines how far a touch event can start away from the view.
Typical interface guidelines recommend touch targets that are at least
30 - 40 points/density-independent pixels.

> The touch area never extends past the parent view bounds and the Z-index
> of sibling views always takes precedence if a touch hits two overlapping
> views.

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#hitslop

## How it works

`Fieldset.Root` groups related fields using `Legend`, `HelperText`, and `ErrorText`. Typography and spacing follow the React component. The legend is exposed as a heading without grouping children into a single accessibility element.

Set `disabled` on the root to disable nested `Field` controls. Nested fieldsets cannot re-enable a disabled parent. Other standalone controls must receive `disabled` explicitly. `invalid` displays the fieldset's `ErrorText` but does not mark every individual field invalid.

`Fieldset.Context` and `useFieldsetContext` expose the current state for custom controls. Use React Native `style` and accessibility props; this port does not use a DOM fieldset or Ark RootProvider.
